record.title: Distinguish the commanded 600 MHz component from the SCPI readback
record.intent: Resolve the survey receive-gate ambiguity without altering the preserved experiment.
requirements: Follow docs/research/rf-frequency-diagnostic-protocol.md after tasking admission and commit/push. No new source command, firmware, entitlement, calibration or wiring transition.

Start a fresh full capture with verified isolated lease/address and recorder termination discipline. Record the original scope/export settings and received level before three fresh qualified raw records at reported 4 GSa/s.

Retain the built-in frequency at 1us/div, acquire three 100k RAW ASCII records, then record the same measurement at 10ns/div after five seconds. Restore all original acquisition/export settings and running acquisition; source remains last commanded600MHz.

Stop on transport/capture/network, invalid raw metadata or range failure; no retries or extra records. Seal/verify acquisition separately before any numerical interpretation and commit/push the bounded acquisition conclusion.
acceptance: Three qualified raw records and paired timebase readbacks or the exact stopped prefix are preserved with restoration and capture evidence.
